popover.primary: A mastery path focused on dealing damage to a single, far-away enemy.
popover.secondary: Bow counts 100% of its dps to abilities, sword counts 45%.

popover.primary: A mastery path focused on fighting in melee combat.
popover.secondary: Sword counts 100% of its dps towards abilities.

popover.primary: A mastery path focused on fighting multiple enemies at medium range.
popover.secondary: Bow counts 100% of its dps to abilities, sword counts 45%.

data.name: Bolster War Engine
data.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
data.description: Siege Targetted buff. Increases damage done by that siege engine by 2% for 10 seconds.

data.name: Hamper War Engine
data.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
data.description: Siege Targetted debuff. Increases the cooldown times of that siege engine by 50% for 10 seconds

data.name: Diminish War Engine
data.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
data.description: Siege Targetted debuff. Decreases damage done by that siege engine to 98% for 10 seconds.

data.name: Scout Stance
data.description:
A long-distance bow stance that increases your Ballistic Skill by 100 and the range of your bow attacks by 10%. Your attacks have a 5% reduced chance to be defended against.

You may only use a single Stance at a time.

data.name: Flee
data.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

data.name: Assault Stance
data.description:
A close-combat stance which increases your Strength, Initiative and Weapon Skill by 100.

While in Assault Stance your ranged prowess item stats will count towards your melee prowess in a 1 to 1 conversion respectively. Parry chance is increased by 10%, Auto Attack Damage is increased by 35%.

You may only use a single Stance at a time.

data.name: Skirmish Stance
data.description:
A close-range bow stance that increases your Initiative by 100 and the chance that your bow attacks will critically hit by 5%. You gain the ability to autoattack while moving while in this stance.

You may only use a single Stance at a time.

data.name: Distracting Shot
data.description: You Detaunt your target, making them hate you less and causing them to deal only 50% damage to you for 15 seconds. You will also deal 50% damage to them until the effect is broken. If you attack anyone that you have Detaunted, the effect will immediately end. While using Assault Stance the duration of Distracting Shot is reduced to 5 seconds, but you will additionally detaunt all enemies within 25 feet around you.

data.name: Hunter's Fervor
data.description: An inspired fervor fills your group, giving 5 Action Points every second for 15 seconds to all groupmates within 100 feet of you.

data.name: Point-Blank
data.description: A mid-range attack that deals 600 damage and knocks the targeted player away. Monsters will be knocked down.

data.name: Centuries of Training
data.description: Upon striking a target with direct damage there is a 25% chance to inflict an additional 303 Spirit damage over 3 seconds.

data.name: Whirling Pin
data.note: You cannot perform this action while airborne
data.description: All enemies within 25 feet become snared, reducing movement speed by 30% for the next 5 seconds. You are knocked back away from your enemies.

data.name: Vengeance of Nagarythe
data.description:
You are filled with a desire for vengeance, increasing all damage you deal by 25% for 10 seconds. During this time some of your abilities will gain additional effects.
Does not affect damage procs.

data.name: Crippling Barrage
data.description: Targeted area-effect attack that deals 900 over 3 seconds to all enemies within 20 feet, and snares the targets by 60%.

data.name: Expert Skirmisher
data.description: Your cast times are reduced to 50% on abilities not requiring any target and for abilities that do, when within 20 feet of your target. Additionally, you are 50% less likely to be set back while casting.

data.name: Replenishing Strikes
data.description: Any time you critically hit an enemy, you will regain 40 Action Points. Tactic can not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

data.name: Masterful Aim
data.description: Increases your Ballistic Skill by 160

data.name: Concealment
data.description: With luck and experience you are able to Dodge all ranged attacks and Disrupt all magic attacks against you for 7 seconds.

data.name: Bend the Winds
data.description: Increases your Elemental resistance by 252.

data.name: Steady Aim
data.description: While this ability is active, your ranged abilities will inflict 25% more critical damage to your offensive target but will cost an additional 5 action points.

data.name: Focused Mind
data.description: For the next 10 seconds, you will remove and ignore any rooting, snaring, disarming, silencing or disabling effects. Your cast times are reduced by 50%, and you cannot be set back.

data.name: Wrist Slash
data.description: Grim Slash will now reduce your enemy's Weaponskill by 150 and Initiative by 150 for 20 seconds, and increase your Weaponskill and Initiative by the same amount.

data.name: Discerning Offense
data.description: Your attacks have a 10% reduced chance to be defended against.

data.name: Explosive Shots
data.description:
All of your ranged attacks will explode for the next 10 seconds, dealing 300 damage to all enemies within 20 feet of your target.
This effect will not trigger more than once every second.

data.name: Clever Recovery
data.description:
If an enemy dodges any of your attacks, you will regain 75 Action Points.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

data.name: Smoldering Arrows
data.description: Flame Arrow's initial hit will now interrupt enemies and  its damage over time is increased to 895 Corporeal damage.

data.name: Lileath's Forgiveness
data.description: Removes all Hexes, Curses, Cripples, and Ailments from you.  Your Armor is increased by 1320 and all your Resistances are increased by 480 for 1 second per effect removed, up to 10 seconds.

data.name: Pierce Defenses
data.description: If an enemy blocks, dodges, or parries any of your attacks, their chances to dodge and parry will be reduced by 10% and their ability to block reduced by 5% for 10 seconds.

data.name: Bolstering Fervor
data.description: The cooldown of Hunter's Fervor is reduced by 30 seconds and affected group members gain 20 Morale per second.

data.name: Ambush
data.description: You become invisible and gain a barrier for up to 10 seconds, absorbing up to 1800 damage. You remain invisible until the barrier is broken or removed. Using any ability while invisible consumes the barrier and causes your next attack within 5 seconds to deal an additional 1200 damage.

data.name: Instinctive Aim
data.description: Increases your Strength, Ballistic Skill, and Weapon Skill by 120, but reduces your Toughness by 120.

data.name: Bullseye
data.description: Whenever you critically hit an enemy, your chance to critically hit is increased by 20% for 5 seconds, but you also become 10% more vulnerable to being critically hit.

data.name: Instill Fear
data.description: You deal 1200 damage to all enemies within 25 feet and staggers the target for up to 6 seconds, preventing all actions unless they are damaged.

data.name: Guerilla Training
data.description:
After switching stance your action point costs are reduced by 25% for 5 seconds. You gain an additional bonus for 5 seconds based on the stance that you enter:
Scout Stance: Auto Attack damage increased by 25%.
Assault Stance: Incoming damage reduced by 15%.
Skirmisher Stance: Movement speed increased by 20%.

data.name: Blood-Soaked War
data.description: Draw Blood will now heal you for 75% of the damage dealt.

data.name: Hail of Doom
data.description: You focus on a spot on the ground, shooting arrows at that spot every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds, hitting all enemies within 20 feet of that area for 300 damage as long as you maintain your concentration.

data.name: Eagle Eye
data.description: A well aimed arrow that deals 487 damage.

data.name: Acid Arrow
data.description: An attack which deals 328 damage and reduces your target's armor by 990 and reduces their chance to block by 10% for 15 seconds.

data.name: Flame Arrow
data.description:
An Ailment which deals 145 Corporeal damage to your target and then explodes, dealing an additional 385 Corporeal damage over 15 seconds to the target and all other enemies within 20 feet of them.
If you are Vengeful, the radius is increased by 10 feet.

data.name: Rapid Fire
data.description:
You move with blinding speed as you quickly fire several shots at your target, dealing 172 damage to the enemy twice per second for up to 3 seconds. This effect will end if you break your concentration, or run out of action points.
If you are Vengeful, Rapid Fire will remove up to one damage absorbing effect.

data.name: Throat Shot
data.description: A Crippling shot that deals 366 damage and silences your target for 4 seconds, making them unable to use magic.

data.name: Leading Shots
data.description: Any time you critically hit with a ranged attack, the chance to critically hit will be increased by 10% for 10 seconds for group members within 100 feet, but this will not affect you.

data.name: Glass Arrow
data.description: Deals 265 damage to your target and reduces range on their abilities to 75% for the next 3 seconds.

data.name: No Quarter
data.description: Eagle's Eye now builds up 1 seconds faster and Acid Arrow now reduces the target's Corporeal Resistance by 360 for 15 seconds.

data.name: Festering Arrow
data.description: You fire a festering arrow dealing 253 Corporeal damage. After 9 seconds the target takes 253 Corporeal damage. This damage is increased by 10% each time you hit the target, up to 100%. If you are Vengeful, Festering Arrow instantly gains 5 stacks.

data.name: Accelerated Decay
data.description: Festering Arrow deals damage an additional time after 4.5 seconds.

data.name: Fell The Weak
data.description: Deals 891 damage if your target is below 30% hit points, or 366 damage otherwise. If you are Vengeful, landing a killing blow with this ability resets the cooldown of your stances and Fell The Weak.

data.name: Rain of Steel
data.description: Your target's Armor is reduced by 1320 and their Resistances are reduced by 480 while all enemies within 20 feet of the target take 300 damage per second. This effect remains second up to 30 seconds as long as you remain stationary and within range of the target.

data.name: Grim Slash
data.description: Deals 277 damage to your target. Your next ranged ability within 10 seconds has its chance of being defended reduced by 100%.

data.name: Brutal Assault
data.note:
Target must be facing away from you
Requires Assault Stance
data.description:
Deals 427 damage to your target, and makes monsters hate you less than normal. Only usable when you are behind the target.
If you are Vengeful, the cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

data.name: Draw Blood
data.description: An Ailment which deals 651 damage over 9 seconds.

data.name: Swift Strikes
data.description:
You unleash a punishing series of attacks on your enemy for up to 3 seconds, striking them twice per second and dealing 129 damage per hit. If the target is building up an ability, then your strikes will deal 204 damage instead. This ability will end if you break your concentration or run out of action points.
If you are Vengeful, your movement speed is increased by 40% for 1 second each time you hit an enemy.

data.name: Crosscut
data.description: You unleash two swift blows upon your enemy that deal 164 damage each, causing them to be 10% more likely to be critically hit by others for 10 seconds.

data.name: Counterstrike
data.description: A quick strike which deals 164 damage to your target and interrupts any ability that they were building up. If an ability is interrupted, that ability has 5 seconds added to its cooldown while your next ability within 10 seconds has its cooldown reduced by 5 seconds.

data.name: Opportunistic Strikes
data.note:
Target must be facing away from you
Requires Assault Stance
data.description: A Precision attack that deals 164 damage. As long as you remain within 25 feet of your target, you continue to slash them every 2 seconds for up to 6 seconds dealing 101 damage with each hit. If the target is ailing, your Strength is increased by 150 for 20 seconds.

data.name: Sinister Assault
data.description: Brutal Assault will now bypass all of the target's armor.

data.name: Shadowstep
data.note:
Requires Assault Stance
You cannot perform this action while rooted
You cannot perform this action while airborne
data.description: You merge with the shadows and appear at your target within the blink of an eye, striking them for 253 damage. If the target dies within 10 seconds, the cooldown of Shadowstep is reduced by 15 seconds.

data.name: No Respite
data.description:
Your damage is increased by 15% when under 45 feet away from your target.
Does not affect damage procs.

data.name: Blurring Blade
data.description: You become one with the shadows, increasing your chance to Parry, Dodge and Disrupt by 35% for 5 seconds, then striking your enemy for 314 damage.

data.name: Merciless Soldier
data.description: Increases the critical damage of your damage Path of Assault abilities by 50% and the critical chance of Swift Strikes and Draw Blood by 25%.

data.name: Exploit Weakness
data.description:
A Crippling attack which deals 352 damage and knocks down your target for 3 seconds.
If you are Vengeful, the target's movement speed is reduced by 40% for 6 seconds.

data.name: Whirling Rage
data.description: Your movement speed is increased by 30% and you become immune to snares and root for 10 seconds. You slash at enemies within 25 feet dealing 300 damage each second for the duration.

data.name: Broadhead Arrow
data.description: An Ailment which deals 1040 damage to your target over 15 seconds.

data.name: Takedown
data.description:
An Ailment which deals 291 damage and snares your target, reducing their run speed by 40% for 8 seconds. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.
If you are Vengeful, then the target will also be knocked down for 2 seconds.

data.name: Spiral-Fletched Arrow
data.description: Deals 291 damage to your target. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

data.name: Eye Shot
data.description: A Crippling shot that deals 253 damage,  reduces your target's Initiative by 150 for 10 seconds. Your melee attacks deal an additional 112 damage to the target. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

data.name: Flanking Shot
data.note:
Requires Skirmish Stance
Target must be facing away from you
data.description:
Deals 441 damage to your target.
If you are Vengeful, then this attack may be used from any position.

data.name: Split Arrows
data.description: Spiral-Fletched Arrow and Broadhead Arrows now hit all enemies within 20 feet of your initial target, but they do 30% less damage.

data.name: Lileath's Arrow
data.description: A piercing arrow which deals 390 damage to all enemies in front of you, up to 65 feet away.  This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

data.name: Keen Arrowheads
data.description: Increases the durations of Broadhead Arrows to 21 seconds, Takedown to 15 seconds, and increases the armor penetration of Lileath's Arrow and Barrage by 15%.

data.name: Shadow Sting
data.description: An Ailment which deals 681 damage to your target over 9 seconds and causes all healing effects used on them to become 50% weaker.  Only usable on a target that is already Ailing.

data.name: Powerful Draw
data.description: Increases the ranges of all Path of the Skirmisher abilities by 15 feet.

data.name: Barrage
data.description:
Deals 390 damage to all enemies in an arc in front of you, up to 40 feet away.
If you are Vengeful, this attack removes 100 points of morale from the enemy.

data.name: Penetrating Arrow
data.description: Deals 1200 damage to all enemies in front of you, up to 40 feet away, and an additional 1200 damage over 5 seconds.
